decks.summary: Blessing Cho who stocks the bag with Ancestral Token and Favor of the Sun to trigger Blessing of Isis, punching with Boxing Gloves and fight events like One-Two Punch and Radiant Smite.
Wushu Cho who wears Boxing Gloves and The Hungering Blade together thanks to Bandolier, softening enemies with fight events and finishing them with the Blade.
Weaponless Cho with Boxing Gloves to draw Spirit events after each kill, Clean Them Out, Monster Slayer and One-Two Punch to kill, and "Get over here!" to pull enemies in.
Fantasy Flight's official Nathaniel Cho starter deck: Boxing Gloves and a repertoire of fight events like Monster Slayer and One-Two Punch, with Grete Wagner and Relentless.
A streamlined version of Nathaniel's starter deck for a multiplayer monster-slayer role, adding Emergency Cache and Evidence! for money and a few clues.
The core-only variant of Nat Comes Out Swinging: Nathaniel's pack plus the Core Set, fight events and Boxing Gloves, with Guts and Overpower in place of the rest.
Bodyguard Cho built to pair with a matching Harvey Walters deck that keeps him stocked with cards, punching with Boxing Gloves and fight events and protecting Harvey with Safeguard.
Double Boxing Gloves Cho made possible by Bandolier, with Randall Cho and Backpack to assemble the kit, Mano a Mano and upgraded Counterpunch, and Spiritual Resolve for Dim Carcosa.
A Spanish-language example Nathaniel: Boxing Gloves and fight events as the specialist combatant, with Grete Wagner, Flesh Ward and Safeguard.
True solo Cho who investigates at 7 to 9 through Bruiser and the Hyperphysical Shotcaster, fighting with Timeworn Brand and events like Grievous Wound.
